name: bake-determinism
description: RFC 0007 determinism lanes (tools/quality/bake_determinism.py): every Cycles pass of the lightmap bake (total, separated direct/indirect layers, sun visibility, RNM basis, tangent frame, coverage) and a small reflection probe, undenoised on the CPU at a small atlas and low sample count, so two builds can be compared bit for bit and a GPU build compared statistically. Not a playable export: the lanes stop after the probe step.
